How to add AI visual effects to your videos without making everything look AI-generated.

Every Friday, my news videos start with some wild AI intro and it's the thing I get asked about the most. This is the full breakdown of how I do it, plus every other AI effect I use to keep my videos fun.

Intros, transitions, background compositing, B-roll, logo reveals, lower thirds, animated infographics, and the animated talking heads trick from the Sam Altman video. I jump between Runway, Seed Dance 2.0, Gemini, Veo 3.1, Remotion, and Codex throughout.

You do not need to be a pro editor. The goal is 95% human video with 5% AI spice.

items.title: The Network at the Heart of AI Factories With NVIDIA Spectrum- X Ethernet​
items.summary:
In this fireside chat, Alan Weckel from 650 Group and NVIDIA’s SVP of Networking, Gilad Shainer, discuss how networking serves as the heart of modern AI factories. The conversation explores the shifting landscape of network architectures as the industry enters an 800 gig upgrade cycle and experiences explosive bandwidth growth. Shainer details four essential networking infrastructures for AI: scale-up via NVLink to create single GPU units, scale-out using Spectrum-X Ethernet to eliminate jitter and achieve 95% effective bandwidth, scale-across for giga-scale factories, and a new context memory storage infrastructure for inferencing. The discussion also highlights the production launch of co-packaged optics (CPO), a significant milestone that reduces optical network power consumption by nearly 5x while increasing reliability.
 
#AIifrastructure, #AIfactory, #acceleratednetworking 

Learn more: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/

items.title: Why is Apple Silicon such a Big Deal for Local AI?
items.summary:
Apple Silicon changed the game for local AI.

In this short, Keiji Kamigusa explains why Macs with Apple Silicon are such a big deal for running AI models locally: they’re powerful, efficient, widely available, and capable of handling serious AI workflows without needing a massive desktop GPU setup.

That means developers can build private chatbots, RAG apps, voice tools, and other AI-powered applications directly on their own machines, keeping data local while still getting practical performance.

If you’ve been wondering whether your Mac is “enough” for local AI, this is the short to watch.

Learn more in Build Applications with Local AI Models on a Mac: https://hubs.la/Q04mY6wQ0

#AppleSilicon #LocalAI #MacAI #AIEngineering #Ollama #PrivateAI #RAG #AIApps #BuildWithAI #ManningBooks

items.title: The Scenario That Makes Extinction Look Merciful
items.summary: In episode 1007 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Benjamin Todd, President of 80000 Hours about S-risks - scenarios where AI systems could create outcomes even worse than human extinction. Todd explains how AI systems might engage in blackmail through simulated suffering and why we should assume digital minds can experience pain. This represents one of the most neglected yet potentially catastrophic risks in AI development.

items.title: Self-Evolving AI: LLM and Harness Together (RSI)
items.summary:
Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) as the bleeding edge of Self-learning LLMs in parallel w/ optimizing Harness elements in one system-wide optimization.
Small and Smart AI = The future for all non 8xB200 NVIDIA owner. 

Finally the "holy grail of AI": Reinforcement Learning of the LLM in parallel with the harness object optimization (prompt engineering, context engineering, loop engineering, system engineering). 

The first steps. With the complete pseudo-code and the maths explained in detail. Coding Agent Harness Self-improvement.
 
Note: 
The latest text by Lilian Weng is the perfect introduction to this video. Read her first to understand the current system complexity (she summed up the main literature of the past 6 months). Then watch this video, because I'll go one step further than Lilian.

The "RSI Roadmap":
Lilian writes (see "Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement", July 4, 2026, https://lilianweng.github.io/posts/20...  ) about the future of AI and states that the optimization targets of the AI industry have evolved to Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI): 

instruction prompts → structured context → workflow → harness code → optimizer code

Lilian Weng outlined how AI is no longer just optimizing prompts, but rewriting its entire operating system (the harness). 
Now today, we - on this YouTube channel -  are looking at a new paper (see below), that represents the absolute bleeding edge of this (also Lilian's) RSI roadmap. 
Self-improving AI systems (LLM and Harness), recursive, without humans in the loop.

all rights w/ authors: 
"Harness-Aware Self-Evolving:
Co-Evolving Model Weights, Harness, and Task Solutions"
Haochen Luo1,3, Yi Huang2, Sichun Luo1,3, Fengyuan Liu1,3,
Lei Li1,3, Zefa Hu2, Junlan Feng2, Qi Liu1,3
from
1 School of Computing and Data Science, The University of Hong Kong
2 Jiutian Research, China Mobile
3 Grace Investment Machine

arXiv:2607.03935

items.title: Mistral OCR 4 + Sparrow: Document to JSON
items.summary:
Follow-up to the Mistral OCR + Sparrow integration video. Mistral released OCR 4 — the latest model with improved accuracy, native bounding box extraction, and structural block labels. One model string change in Sparrow to pick it up.

In this video, extracting a long financial statement table into structured JSON using Mistral OCR 4 + Mistral Small 4.

Sparrow is open source and local-first by design — documents never leave your infrastructure unless you choose the cloud backend.

items.title: AI Can FINALLY Edit Videos For You
items.summary:
Imagine typing "edit this for me" and letting AI handle your entire video timeline. 🤯

That's the promise behind Palmier (not sponsored), a new AI video editor powered by Claude. From organizing media and trimming clips to generating missing B-roll on the fly, it’s designed to automate the manual side of editing.

At $29/month for around 3 to 7 minutes of generated video, it's not the cheapest product to use, especially when you factor in potential revisions. BUT it's still probably cheaper than a professional video editor. 

I haven’t run any footage through it yet, but I'm curious to see how it performs and if it's worth it. Let me know in the comments if you'd want to see a hands-on test 👇🏻

#ai #videoediting #contentcreator
